name: Melodic Mix
blurb: Melodic Mix is a powerful yet simple tool, for applying effects and mixing instruments and vocals in live performances, many effects like a bass enhancer or reverb can be used.
description:
Melodic Mix is a powerful yet simple tool, for applying effects and mixing instruments and vocals in live performances, many effects like a bass enhancer or reverb can be used.

It is a fork of Easy Effects, but it's not meant to replace it, but to be used for a entierly different purpose.

Even recording and live streaming through external apps can be done using the virtual source Melodic Mix creates, it acts like a speaker in the app, but any app can use it like if it were a microphone.

Mixing and controlling output levels is easily accomplished using the mixer UI, where all functions for mixing and volume regulation are in one place.

Profiles can be created for easily and quickly setting up for different music pieces.

Note: Melodic Mix requires PipeWire and won't work without it!

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
